                               NOTICE OF WITHDRAWAL AS COUNSEL

                Gentner F. Drummond, the Attorney General of Oklahoma, on behalf of the utility

         customers of this State, hereby submits this Notice of Withdrawal as Counsel for Thomas

         Grossnicklaus and Meghan Wan. The Attorney General will continue to be represented by the

         other undersigned counsel below.
